Refresh Browser About this product Product Information If you're searching for a heavy metal guitar sound that's ideal for live performances, consider using the DigiTech X-Series Metal Master distortion effects pedal. This high-quality musical device provides guitarists with three distinct effects sounds, which is great for musicians who have varied performance styles. This well-constructed, versatile pedal is built stand up to the rigors of the road. Touring musicians will find that these pedals make great traveling accessories.The Metal Master pedal features DigiTech's impressive AudioDNA technology. Use it with guitars to create a wide array of distortion sounds and effects. The pedal gives electric guitarists complete control over their style thanks to the device's four separate knobs. The first dial is for Level, which gives users control over the effect's output level. The Low control is used to alter the cut and boost of low frequencies while the High knob controls the cut and boost of high frequencies. To morph between the three metal distortion effects, guitarists use the Morph control. Use this dial to create a smooth high gain tone, a scooped mid-range sound, and a punchy mid-range metal sound. By combining these distinct guitar effects, musicians create a music texture that is unique.DigiTech creates products that help musicians refine and individualize their tone. The X-Series Metal Master has separate low and high spectral-contouring EQ. This means that the device adjusts a broader range of frequencies than many typical stompboxes. These DigiTech pedals also feature dual amp and mixer outputs with optional cabinet modeling circuitry. The pedal's advance CIT cabinet modeling technology ensures that guitarists achieve authentic guitar amplifier sounds, even without amps.These heavy metal distortion pedal accessories are housed in a sturdy metal chassis. It measures approximately 5 x 3 x 2 inches and weighs only 1.38 pounds. The design is an appealing combination of rugged and lightweight. sources.excerpt: X-Series Metal Master by DigiTech | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE DigiTech X-Series Metal Master LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION Description The Metal Master is the world’s most advanced heavy metal distortion pedal. DigiTech’s exclusive AudioDNA™ technology is what makes the Metal Master more than your standard distortion stompbox. Rather than working from a single distortion type circuit with tone controls, the Metal Master features a Morph knob which blends between three totally different metal distortion types. This gives you a wide variety of different metal distortion sounds that can be dialed in quickly and easily. Tweet Don't settle for one distortion pedal when you can have 3 built into one stomp box! Introducing the Metal Master pedal from DigiTech. This pedal will give you the arsenal you need to tear the heads off of your crowd! Use the Morph knob to morph between a smooth high gain tone, to a scooped midrange sound, all the way to a punchy mid range heavy metal sound that will cut through ANY mix! You strive to make your music unique and DigiTech gives you the power to create that unique sound in one pedal. In order to give you more options than anyone else and further refine your tone, DigiTech put in separate low and high spectral-contouring EQ and dual amp/mixer outputs with optional cabinet modeling circuitry.
